lexical.candidate_recall_scope: entity ID at exactly detected core; nominal full boundary reported separately
lexical.catalog_scope: complete registered catalog for each family, not a global deployment glossary
lexical.full_span_contract: semantic nominal surface excludes grammatical particles; raw full_span is not compared to nominal gold
lexical.ranking_scope: entity ranking conditional on gold in actual budgeted candidates; exact-link correctness additionally requires nominal full span
lexical.selection_limit: previous corpus was authored around registered aliases and fixed candidate families; actual resolve integration does not create an independent general retrieval benchmark

limitations: Older development and heldout cohorts are exposed diagnostics.
New business cases are AI authored and reviewed, with related templates and one registered entity per family.
Frozen exploratory thresholds are not fitted or certified for the new actual-candidate distribution.
Semantic evidence selection does not override structural guards or grant execution authority.
